title: ETH: Data-Balanced Heterogeneous Pipeline Parallelism for Training Large Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.22035v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Current heterogeneity-aware training systems for large models balance workloads by assigning unequal numbers of layers across pipeline stages, a strategy aimed at equalizing execution time through a unique pipeline configuration. However, this approach fails to address critical memory constraints and suffers from inherently coarse balancing granularity.   In this paper, we propose Heterogeneous Pipeline Parallelism (HPP), a novel approach enabling efficient and fine-grained data balance across heterogeneous pipelines. To address HPP's key challenges, prohibitive search overhead for optimal configurations and high communication overhead from asymmetric All-Reduce, we design the ETH training system. ETH employs a hierarchical workload balance framework that jointly optimizes balance across heterogeneous pipelines and within individual pipeline stages. translated_title: ETH：面向大模型训练的数据均衡异构流水线并行
translated_abstract: 当前面向大模型的异构感知训练系统通过在流水线各阶段分配不等数量的层来平衡工作负载，这种策略旨在通过独特的流水线配置使各阶段执行时间相等。然而，这种方法未能解决关键的内存限制问题，且平衡粒度存在天然粗糙的缺陷。本文提出了异构流水线并行（HPP），这是一种能够在异构流水线之间实现高效、细粒度数据均衡的新方法。为解决HPP面临的关键挑战——最优配置搜索开销过大以及非对称All-Reduce带来的高通信开销——我们设计了ETH训练系统。ETH采用分层工作负载均衡框架，联合优化异构流水线之间以及单个流水线内部各阶段的负载均衡。为降低非对称通信开销，ETH实现了分块梯度聚合机制。
tldr: 该论文提出异构流水线并行方法（HPP）及ETH训练系统，通过分层工作负载均衡框架和分块梯度聚合技术，在异构流水线间实现细粒度数据均衡，同时解决了配置搜索开销大和非对称All-Reduce通信开销高的关键难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Heterogeneous Pipeline Parallelism (HPP) and the ETH training system, which achieves fine-grained data balancing across heterogeneous pipelines through a hierarchical workload balance framework and block-wise gradient aggregation, addressing the prohibitive configuration search overhead and high asymmetric All-Reduce communication costs.
